items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Trent died in his hometown, Fort Smith all this long. ... Oh, just some guy picked up Trent's name and used it. Trent never had a number two band.

ctx.x: Oh, whatever happened to Trent now?
Trent died in his hometown, Fort Smith all this long.
But did he break his band up or were they going to decline or what?
